vulnerability_cn: 零知识证明验证结果检查错误（事件关联待补）
vulnerability_en: Incorrect ZK-Proof Result Check (Incident Correlation Incomplete)
detail_cn: 官方事发前代码依赖 masp_proofs 3.0.9，其 BatchValidator.validate() 对 Result<bool, SynthesisError> 只检查 is_err()，因此代表证明无效的 Ok(false) 未被拒绝。官方 MASP PR #114 和 Namada masp-drain-fix PR #5026 提供修复与假证明回归测试。原表未提供攻击交易；此源码缺陷与本次约 60 万美元流出的逐笔对应尚未完成，不能把 IBC 转出路径直接当成已确认根因。
detail_en: Pre-incident upstream code pins masp_proofs 3.0.9. BatchValidator.validate() checks only is_err() on Result<bool, SynthesisError>, so Ok(false) for an invalid proof is not rejected. MASP PR #114 and Namada masp-drain-fix PR #5026 provide the fix and fake-proof regression test. The sheet supplies no attack transaction; transaction-level correlation with this approximately $600K drain remains incomplete. IBC outflow alone does not establish the root cause.
native_component: Namada MASP / shielded_token; no EVM contract address
